name: prompt-deepener
description: Deepen a prompt before sending it: an Improve button (ctrl+x d) and a ++ marker run it through your improver text, show four answers, and put a deeper rewrite in the draft.

improverText.title: Improver text
improverText.description: The instruction a prompt is run through when deepened. Default is the original deeper-not-bigger text.
improverText.default: I want a deeper version of this task, not a bigger one. Before rewriting it: (1) say what a top professional in this field would do here that I'm not asking for; (2) name the rawest material they would start from instead of what has already been digested for me; (3) name the specific methods and tools they would use; (4) say what, other than you or me, would show the result is right. Then rewrite my prompt to ask for exactly that.
